nodes.name: Lookup Context
nodes.notes: Stores the raw message first (nothing is lost if later steps fail), dedupes webhook retries, finds the job/customer and repeat-customer history.

nodes.name: Claude: Score & Draft
nodes.notes: Structured JSON output (sentiment, severity, issues, draft reply). If this fails the rules engine scores alone - feedback is never dropped.

nodes.name: Save Feedback, Case & Alerts
nodes.notes: One transaction: feedback + status label, case with SLA, draft reply (never auto-sent), Ready-to-Post entry, outbox messages.

nodes.name: Wake Dispatcher
nodes.notes: Wakes the Outbox Dispatcher so alerts go out now instead of on the next 1-minute tick. Failure is harmless (the 1-minute schedule still runs). On n8n Cloud, set the Variable RFE_INTERNAL_URL to your instance URL if your plan has Variables.
